title: The Cambridge History of Medieval English Literature
reliability_notes: The standard collaborative history of English literature 1066–1547; used as the primary framework for period coverage, movements, and canonical selection.

title: The Cambridge Companion to Medieval English Literature 1100–1500
reliability_notes: Authoritative survey essays on the literature of the period; used for contextual and critical verification.

title: A Book of Middle English, 4th edition
author_or_editor: J. A. Burrow and Thorlac Turville-Petre
reliability_notes: The standard teaching edition of early Middle English texts with grammar and glossary; used for textual and linguistic verification of the earlier works.

title: Middle English Dictionary
author_or_editor: Robert E. Lewis et al. (eds.), Middle English Compendium
publisher: University of Michigan Press / University of Michigan Library
reliability_notes: The standard lexicographical resource for Middle English (1100–1500); used for linguistic verification.

title: The Riverside Chaucer, 3rd edition
reliability_notes: The standard complete edition of Chaucer's works with introductions and notes; used for all Chaucerian records.

title: English Historical Documents, Volume II: 1042–1189
author_or_editor: David C. Douglas and George W. Greenaway (eds.)
reliability_notes: Standard collection of translated primary documents for the Norman and Angevin periods.

title: English Historical Documents, Volume III: 1189–1327
reliability_notes: Standard collection of translated primary documents for the thirteenth and early fourteenth centuries.

title: TEAMS Middle English Texts Series
author_or_editor: Russell A. Peck (gen. ed.); Consortium for the Teaching of the Middle Ages
publisher: Medieval Institute Publications, Western Michigan University
reliability_notes: Open-access scholarly editions of Middle English texts (romances, drama, devotional prose); used for textual verification of works without modern print editions in hand.

title: Oxford Dictionary of National Biography
author_or_editor: H. C. G. Matthew and Brian Harrison (eds.); online edition
reliability_notes: The standard biographical reference; used for author dates, careers, and biographical verification.
